Name: Auto Trasher
Author: Jag3dagster
Description:
Auto Trasher is an open-source mod for [url=https//stardewvalley.net]Stardew Valley[/url] that allows players to automatically send unwanted items to their trash bin.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TcdN9b9.gif[/img]

[size=4][u][b]Documentation
[/b][/u][/size][size=3][u]Overview
[/u][/size]This mod allows users to specify items that they would like to automatically send to their trash bin as soon as the item enters their inventory.

[size=3][u]Config
[/u][/size][list]
[*][b]ToggleTrasherKeybind[/b]
[list][*]Keybind(s) to toggle the Auto Trasher functionality
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]LeftAlt + R, RightAlt + R[/b]
[/list][*][b]OpenTrashMenuKeybind[/b]
[list][*]Keybind(s) used to open the Trash List Management menu
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]LeftAlt + L, RightAlt + L[/b]
[/list][*][b]AddTrashKeybind[/b]
[list][*]Keybind(s) used to add an item to the Trash List
[list][*][i]Note:[/i] You must have the item that you want to add selected in the inventory menu when using this keybind
[/list][*][i]Default:[/i] [b]LeftAlt + X, RightAlt + X[/b]
[/list][*][b]ReclaimableItemCount[/b]
[list][*]Number of items to keep a history of as reclaimable
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]10[/b]
[/list][*][b]AllowAllItems[/b]
[list][*]Whether or not to allow adding all types of items to the Trash List
[*][i]Default:[/i] [b]false[/b]
[/list][*][b]TrashList[/b]
[list][*]List of Object Ids that will be automatically sent to the trash whenever they enter your inventory
[list][*][i]Note:[/i] The Auto Trasher only works with Object type items from the [i]Data\Objects[/i] data file
[*][i]Note:[/i] This option will not appear in Generic Mod Config Menu, and is instead managed via the Trash List Menu and Add Trash Keybind
[/list][*][i]Default:[/i] [b][ "(O)168", "(O)169", "(O)170", "(O)171", "(O)172", "(O)747", "(O)748" ][/b]
[list][*][i]Note:[/i] This list equates to [b][ Trash, Driftwood, Broken Glasses, Broken CD, Soggy Newspaper, Rotten Plant, Rotten Plant ][/b]
[/list][/list][/list]

[size=3][u]Install[/u][/size][list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][list=1][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Nexus Mirror[/url]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]GitHub Mirror[/url]
[/list]
[*][i]Optional but recommended[/i] Install the latest version of [url=https://spacechase0.com/mods/stardew-valley/generic-mod-config-menu/]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][list=1][*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Nexus Mirror[/url]
[/list]
[*]Install this mod by unzipping the mod folder into 'Stardew Valley/Mods'
[*]Launch the game using SMAPI
[/list]

[size=3][u]Compatibility[/u][/size][list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts[list]
[*]If you find one please feel free to notify me here or on [url=https://github.com/jag3dagster/AutoShaker]GitHub[/url]﻿
[/list]
[/list]
[size=3][u]Limitations[/u][/size]
[u]Solo + Multiplayer[/u][list]
[*]This mod is player specific, each player that wants to utilize it must have it installed
[/list]
